Function: - Pots are wired to ADC1 pins only (not ADC2), since ADC2 shares hardware with Wi-Fi and gets unreliable if Wi-Fi is enabled.
- Footswitches and the momentary switch should go through debounce (RC or firmware-side) to avoid multiple triggers from mechanical bounce.
- GPIO assignment is flexible: the ESP32-S3's GPIO matrix lets I2S/I2C be remapped to almost any pin, so pins can be swapped in firmware without a hardware change.
